name: centro-estetica-camila-gonzalez
description: Sistema de turnos — Camila González Belleza

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,client-publico -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=client-publico"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=client-publico
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=client-publico
